description: Returns submissions from a site's contact or booking-request form, newest first. A site's HTML form posts to https://deed.page/v1/forms/{slug} (Hobby and Pro); each non-spam submission is also emailed to the owner's verified recovery email. Inputs: slug, optional limit (1 to 200, default 20), include_spam, and token. Read-only: delete with DELETE /v1/sites/{slug}/forms/{id}. Returns endpoint, email status, totals, and submissions (id, form, at, fields, spam, email). Free returns forms_required with an upgrade link. Forms never accept passwords, card numbers, bank or ID numbers, or file uploads.

include_spam.description: Include submissions the spam filter flagged. Default false.

limit.description: How many submissions to return, 1 to 200. Default 20.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: form_submissions
title: Read contact form submissions
